summary: Weekend scan found no normal Sunday arXiv announcement cycle; the newest relevant material on arXiv recent pages remains the late-week Aug. 27-28 postings. Selected papers emphasize BMS/color-coherence jet-quenching theory, saturation analogies for medium-modified jet evolution, inhomogeneous-magnetic-field QCD phases, p-O charged-particle phenomenology, conditional diffusion for TMD inference, cross-simulator foundation-model summaries, and quantum-kernel tracking benchmarks with clear noise caveats.
strongest_paper: 2608.25984 and 2608.25983 together are the strongest heavy-ion contribution: they offer a coherent perturbative framework connecting QGP color decoherence with BMS/BK-style nonlinear evolution.
candidate_pool_note: Inspected latest arXiv recent listings for nucl-th, nucl-ex, hep-ph, physics.data-an, and cs.LG. No normal Sunday new-paper cycle was visible; newest relevant listings were primarily Aug. 27-28, with a small number of Aug. 25-26 items retained only when scientifically useful.

papers.title: Color Coherence and the Soft Structure of QCD Jets in Vacuum and the QGP
papers.abstract: Formulates QCD jet evolution in vacuum and QGP through large-energy-log resummation using Wilson-line correlators obeying BMS evolution.

papers.title: Jet Quenching Meets Gluon Saturation
papers.abstract: Presents a framework for jet fragmentation in heavy-ion collisions where BMS evolution and medium-induced decoherence connect to saturation physics.

papers.title: Chiral soliton lattice in inhomogeneous magnetic fields
papers.abstract: Studies whether CSL-like QCD ground states persist in nonuniform magnetic fields relevant to heavy-ion collisions and neutron stars.

papers.title: Particle production in p-O collisions at LHC energy
papers.abstract: Compares a three-source relativistic diffusion model for p-O charged-hadron production with preliminary ALICE Run 3 data.

papers.title: Learning Transverse Momentum Distributions from Raw Scattering Events via Conditional Diffusion
papers.abstract: Uses conditional diffusion to infer TMD PDFs from raw simulated SIDIS events with uncertainty narrowing as event counts increase.

papers.title: Cross-simulator transfer with foundation model summaries
papers.abstract: Tests self-supervised frozen summaries for simulator-shift-robust 21 cm simulation-based inference.

papers.title: Evaluating Quantum Kernel Methods for Track-Based Classification in High-Energy Physics
papers.abstract: Scales an exact quantum-kernel track-classification benchmark and quantifies strong performance loss under a calibrated noise model.

cautions.title: Classical and Hybrid Quantum Machine Learning for Trigger-Like Event Selection on CMS Open Data
